Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea

Class UmbilicalStructuralCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea.UmbilicalStructuralCalculator
public final class UmbilicalStructuralCalculator extends Object
Structural screening calculations for umbilicals: tube burst and collapse, helical armour wire capacity, free-hanging catenary tension and cross-section packing.

Tube wall thickness for internal pressure follows the ASME B31.3 style expression t = P ID / (2 (S + P Y - P)) with S = usage factor * SMYS and Y = 0.4. Collapse under external hydrostatic pressure uses the DNV-ST-F101 combined elastic/plastic collapse equation with initial ovality. Armour wires are helical with lay angle alpha measured from the umbilical axis, so a layer holds n = pi D cos(alpha) / d_w wires, each carrying A_w sigma cos(alpha) axially. The catenary is the classical inextensible free-hanging solution with a horizontal tangent at touchdown. All values are screening level; standard safety factors must be confirmed against the governing standard (API 17E / ISO 13628-5, DNV-ST-F101).
